title: Truely Vanilla
body:
Truely Vanilla is a Vanilla-like modpack, containing mostly optimizations, with a few additional mods like "Nullscape" to give the end some life, and "Dark Loading Screen" for those late nights when your on the grind.

![32 chunks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d6015fd5b09f11eee8a290e3374a5d8eb697496.png)

With a high level of optimizations, you should be able to also customize this modpack. Add Create, Axiom, or even Cobblemon! This modpack aims to be what Current Vanilla Minecraft is and should be!

**Dont let your adveture wait!**
